tagline: Calendly-style booking app in a single Go binary with SQLite, an API-first design and built-in MCP server.
description: Calnode is a self-hosted scheduling app that ships as one static Go binary with an embedded SQLite database. There is no Redis, no PostgreSQL and no separate API server. Try it with one docker run command that mounts a data folder; for real use you add HTTPS, a persistent encryption key and backups, and Litestream handles point-in-time backup of the SQLite file. It offers booking pages, an embeddable widget, team routing modes (fixed, round-robin, collective, priority), Google Calendar and Microsoft 365 conflict checks, and Stripe Checkout for paid bookings. A REST API with HMAC-signed webhooks is the main control surface, and an MCP server is built into the binary so AI agents can list slots and book. Optional video rooms with recording and AI notes use LiveKit, which you host or rent. Nothing is paywalled for self-hosting, and the licence is Apache-2.0. It replaces Calendly for the core booking job. Several features depend on outside services, such as Deepgram for transcripts.
strengths: Single static binary with embedded SQLite, so a small VPS and one docker run are enough
REST API with 88 endpoints and HMAC-signed webhooks configured through the API
MCP server compiled into the binary, with stdio and Streamable HTTP transports
Team routing modes: fixed, round-robin, collective and priority
Paid bookings through Stripe Checkout, with automatic refund on cancel
Apache-2.0 licence and the README says nothing is paywalled for self-hosting
limits: Video rooms, recording and AI notes need a LiveKit server, and transcripts use Deepgram
The admin interface and built-in video room are English-only, and other translations are machine drafts
OpenAPI spec, metrics endpoint and multi-domain support are still on the roadmap
One deployment is one workspace (instance-per-tenant), so there is no shared multi-tenant mode
bestFor: A developer or small agency that wants a lean Calendly replacement on a cheap VPS and plans to let AI agents or scripts handle bookings.
